publishedRecipe.name: "BLT" Macaroni Salad with Crispy Bacon, Tomato, Lettuce & Bread Crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium carrots
2 sticks celery
2 tomatoes
2 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl and set aside.

When the bacon is done, remove all but 4 teaspoons of drippings from the skillet, then return to medium heat. Add bread crumbs and toast, stirring often, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to a small bowl, then add garlic powder and salt; stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup panko bread crumbs
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Stir to combine the macaroni salad.
Separate lettuce into leaves and arrange on plates. Top with macaroni salad, bread crumbs, and crispy bacon. Enjoy!
